services.name: Birthday Party
services.desc: Whether hosting a small social gathering or a grand celebration, The DoSeum offers a versatile selection of spaces to create a unique and festive atmosphere. In each area of our 104,000 sq. foot building, you will find the flexibility to choose a single space, multiple levels or a custom selection to meet your needs. Interactive exhibits are available for event-goers to discover, explore, create, and learn. Weddings Graduation Parties Birthdays Anniversaries Baby Showers Baptisms First Communions Quinces Bat mitzvahs & Bar mitzvahs Bachelorette & Bachelor Parties Team Building Press Events Conferences Luncheons Award Ceremonies Holiday Parties Team Meetings Cocktail Events Receptions

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Take learning beyond the classroom! Field trips at The DoSeum bring STEM, the arts, and early literacy to life through hands-on learning. From school groups and scouts to camps and organizations, every visit is an opportunity to spark curiosity and inspire discovery. Designed for school-age children up to age 11, DoSeum field trips keep minds at play! Ready to plan your visit? We're now accepting field trip requests for the 2026-2027 school year, beginning September 1. Please submit your request at least one month in advance using the online request form below.
